description: Read recent Docker logs from the configured static or primary dynamic local-ydb container. Use when bootstrap, restart, or readiness checks fail; target selects the container role and lines controls the tail length.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to read. Defaults to 200.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

target.description: Container role to read logs from: static node or primary dynamic tenant node.

name: local_ydb_container_logs
